title: Site rule
description: How to find, merge and clean an article on one news site (or one shared platform). See docs/RULES.md.

id.description: Stable identifier; also the file name.

domains.description: Registrable domains. Subdomains match automatically (news.detik.com matches detik.com).

articleUrl.description: Regex (JS syntax, no slashes) tested against URL pathname. Only matching pages are treated as articles.

body.description: CSS selectors for the article body, tried in order. First selector that matches wins.

bodyAll.description: Concatenate ALL elements matching the winning body selector (e.g. sites that put every page inline).

remove.description: CSS selectors removed from inside the body (Baca Juga boxes, embedded videos, promos).

dropParagraphs.description:
Extra regexes (case-insensitive) on a block's text; matching

/

blocks are removed. Added to rules/common.json patterns.

variants.description: Overrides for sections with a different layout (e.g. liputan6.com/bola). First variant whose pathname regex matches is merged over the base rule.

logo.description: Escape hatch only: CSS selectors for the header logo when automatic detection picks the wrong image. Leave unset normally; the logo and its background are detected from the live page.

feed.description: RSS feed used only by the daily canary to discover fresh articles.

samples.description: Real article URLs used by tests/canary. Include a multi-page one if the site paginates.

verified.description: Date the selectors were last checked against the live site.

pagination.description: Model borrowed from AutoAllPage (method/fullpage), extended with fetch + inline.

oneOf.description: All pages are already in the DOM. Use with bodyAll.

fullpage.description: Query parameter that returns the whole article, e.g. page=all or single=1.

stripPathPage.description: Remove a trailing /N page segment before adding the param (Detik-style URLs).

onlyIf.description: CSS selector; only fetch the full version if this exists on the page (avoids a useless request on single-page articles).

oneOf.description: Fetch the same URL with the full-page parameter and take its body.

pageLinks.description: CSS selector for numbered page links. Links whose text is a number > 1 are fetched in order and their bodies appended.

oneOf.description: No working full-page URL: download each page and stitch the bodies.
